note: Role: distributor/importer of electronic components (diodes, LEDs, relays, reed switches, ICs) — the customs rows show Navion as BUYER on inbound lanes (Hong Kong, Ningbo, Tokyo Narita, Seoul Incheon) and as SELLER on the one outbound lane to London Heathrow. Declared HS set (841290; 853690; 853890; 854129) does not match the observed codes: actual codes seen are 85414100 (LED), 85364900 (relay), 85411000 (diode), 85365090 (reed switch), 85423100 (IC). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the observed 8536/8541 family, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) is contradicted by the shipment evidence: this is electronics components trading, not mining. Export side is genuinely confirmed by a dated B/L record, not by a website claim. Caveats: (1) only 5 of 894 rows were visible in the free view, so the export sample is thin — one outbound record seen, direction and counterparty consistent across two blocks; (2) volza, eximpedia, trademo and importgenius all returned 403/JS-challenge and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (connection refused), so no independent second source could be cross-checked; (3) revenue and export volume figures are not public in the reachable sources — left null, not estimated; (4) no CIN/PAN captured, so no registry-level confirmation of legal existence was performed in this pass.
